findings.title: Final account check can restart loading wait after body verification
findings.trigger: Final body complete, account locator count=0 once; body changes during 100ms polling pause with URL and title unchanged
findings.observed: ok=true returns original body while actual body changed
findings.expected: Reject unstable final observation without restarting readiness polling

findings.title: Standalone preview identity is unchecked after final body evaluation
findings.observed: Successful observation remote_id=900 but URL points to book200/remote901; upstream observation parser discards URL
findings.expected: Bind expected target through final read and recheck identity before accepting result

findings.title: Recovery centers do not consume the paginated material contract
findings.trigger: Production-saved recovery follows 5001 unrelated draft files
findings.observed: Editor claims no disk recoveries after incomplete first scan; shelf raises workbench_scan_limit; second catalog batch and direct open find intact recovery
findings.expected: Enumerate recovery records with pagination and report incomplete coverage instead of empty state

scope: Eight skill entrypoints, core commands, platform drivers, workbench/archives, desktop/service and distribution; native Windows and real remote platforms not exercised
